subject: OPTIONS paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1508 (landed w1032d). Rule (PDF p302 / folio 272, rendered and inspected): 'OPTIONS. [ arithmetic-clause ] [ default-rounded-clause ] [ entry-convention-clause ] [ float-binary-clause ] [ float-decimal-clause ] [ initialize-clause ] [ intermediate-rounding-clause ] [.]' - seven SEPARATE brackets in a fixed sequence, no choice indicators, no ellipsis, and an independent [.]. cite.py --check 11.9.2 "[ intermediate-rounding-clause ]" -> OK; --check 5.2.1 "shall be written in the compilation group in the sequence given in the general format, unless otherwise specified by the rules of that format" -> OK (11.9.3 has one rule, the period, and frees no order); --check 5.2.6.2 "may be explicitly specified or that portion of the general format may be omitted" -> OK; --check 5.2.7 "applies to the portion of the format between the determined pair of delimiters" -> OK. CODE: the grammar keeps the order-free `optionsClause+` superset (each clause opens on a distinct keyword) and ClauseCardinalities.ByClauseContext[OptionsClauseContext] narrows it - Repeatable empty, Sequence = the seven clause contexts in printed order - read by ClosedFormatPass.ScreenClauseRepetition: an element written after one the figure prints later is COBOL2987 (format-element-out-of-order, at the misplaced clause), a repeat is COBOL2423 (at the second occurrence). The independent [.] is `optionsParagraph : OPTIONS DOT (optionsClause+ DOT | DOT)?` - the bracket plus SR-11.9.3-1 - so `OPTIONS. .` and `OPTIONS.` + a lone `.` line compile (2002 golden). MEASURED (w1032d build): reorder.cob -> COBOL2987 at 2014/2023 (was clean, printed 1); dup.cob -> COBOL2423 (was clean, last clause won, printed 2); twodots.cob / twolines.cob -> compile and run (were COBOL0001); all seven clauses in printed order compile and run B=1 W=[ZZZZ] (2023 golden). ClauseCardinalityDriftTests requires the Sequence to rank exactly the list's once-only alternatives, so a new OPTIONS clause cannot arrive unranked. The edition gate is unchanged: 85 refuses the paragraph (COBOL0804), 2002 refuses the 2014 clauses (COBOL0900). || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (not 85): the OPTIONS paragraph is a 2002 element (its ARITHMETIC clause's Standard Arithmetic was obsolete in 2014 and removed per Annex E.2 item 21); the seven-clause list is the 2023 format - initialize-clause is new in 2023 (Annex E.3 item 33), the other five non-ARITHMETIC clauses 2014
